cards.audioText: What hobbies do you have?
cards.referenceText: A suitable example would be reading, hiking and taking photographs. Reading helps me relax, while hiking keeps me active. Photography also encourages me to notice details when I travel.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是阅读、徒步和摄影。阅读能让我放松，徒步则帮助我保持活力。摄影还会促使我在旅行时留意更多细节。

cards.audioText: What do you like to do when you are not flying?
cards.audioTextZh: 不飞行时你喜欢做什么？
cards.referenceText: A suitable example would be spending time with family, exercising and reading when I am not flying. These activities help me recover from work and maintain a balanced routine. On longer breaks, I might also take a short trip.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是，不飞行时我会陪伴家人、锻炼和阅读。这些活动有助于我在工作后恢复精力，并保持规律、平衡的生活。假期较长时，我也可能安排一次短途旅行。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy traveling?
cards.referenceText: One suitable sample answer is that I enjoy traveling because it lets me experience different places and cultures. I also like trying local food and learning how people live. Good planning makes the journey more relaxing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是，我喜欢旅行，因为旅行让我体验不同的地方和文化。我也喜欢品尝当地食物，了解人们的生活方式。做好规划会让旅程更加轻松。

cards.audioText: Have you ever traveled abroad?
cards.referenceText: An adjustable example is that I have traveled abroad for a short holiday. I prepared my documents and itinerary in advance and used English during the trip. The experience helped me become more confident in an unfamiliar environment.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个可调整的示范答案是，我曾经出国度过一个短假。我提前准备好证件和行程，并在旅途中使用英语。这段经历让我在陌生环境中变得更自信。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy listening to music?
cards.referenceText: One possible sample answer is that I enjoy listening to music during my free time. It helps me relax after a busy day and improves my mood. I usually choose calm music when I need to rest.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是，我空闲时喜欢听音乐。音乐能让我在忙碌一天后放松，也能改善心情。需要休息时，我通常会选择舒缓的音乐。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy watching movies?
cards.referenceText: A model personal answer is that I enjoy watching movies, especially when I have a quiet evening. Movies are entertaining and can also show different cultures or points of view. I normally watch one at home rather than going out.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个个人示范答案是，我喜欢看电影，尤其是在晚上比较安静的时候。电影既有娱乐性，也能展现不同的文化和观点。我通常在家看电影，而不是外出观看。

cards.audioText: What type of movie do you like best?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪种类型的电影？
cards.referenceText: One suitable example is that I like science-fiction movies best. I enjoy stories about technology, exploration and difficult decisions. A good film in this genre can be exciting without being too complicated.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是，我最喜欢科幻电影。我喜欢有关科技、探索和艰难抉择的故事。一部好的科幻片既可以很精彩，也不必过于复杂。

cards.audioText: What's your favorite movie?
cards.referenceText: One suitable sample answer is that my favorite movie is The Martian. I like its focus on problem-solving, teamwork and staying calm under pressure. The story is serious but also has some humor.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是，我最喜欢的电影是《火星救援》。我喜欢影片中解决问题、团队合作以及在压力下保持冷静的主题。故事很严肃，但也带有一些幽默。

cards.audioText: Who is your favorite movie star?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的电影明星是谁？
cards.referenceText: An adjustable example is that my favorite movie star is Tom Hanks. I like the natural way he plays different kinds of characters. Many of his films also tell clear and meaningful stories.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个可调整的示范答案是，我最喜欢的电影演员是汤姆·汉克斯。我喜欢他塑造不同类型角色时自然的表演方式。他的许多电影也讲述了清晰而有意义的故事。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy reading?
cards.referenceText: One possible sample answer is that I enjoy reading because it helps me relax and learn. I usually read non-fiction, aviation articles and an occasional novel. Even twenty minutes of reading can be a useful break from a screen.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是，我喜欢阅读，因为阅读能让我放松和学习。我通常会读非虚构作品、航空文章，偶尔也读小说。即使只读二十分钟，也能让我暂时离开屏幕、得到有益的休息。

cards.audioText: What is your favorite book?
cards.referenceText: A model personal answer is that my favorite book is The Little Prince. Its language is simple, but it raises thoughtful questions about responsibility and relationships. It is also easy to read again at different stages of life.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个个人示范答案是，我最喜欢的书是《小王子》。它的语言很简单，却提出了有关责任和人际关系的深刻问题。在人生的不同阶段，这本书也很适合重新阅读。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy sports or outdoor activities?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢运动或户外活动吗？
cards.referenceText: One suitable sample answer is that I enjoy both sports and outdoor activities. I often jog or hike because they require little equipment and fit easily into my schedule. They help me stay healthy and manage stress.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是，我既喜欢体育运动，也喜欢户外活动。我经常慢跑或徒步，因为这些活动不需要太多装备，也容易安排进日常计划。它们能帮助我保持健康并缓解压力。

cards.audioText: What is your favorite sport?
cards.referenceText: An adjustable example is that my favorite sport is swimming. It exercises the whole body without putting too much stress on the joints. I also find the steady rhythm relaxing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个可调整的示范答案是，我最喜欢的运动是游泳。它能锻炼全身，同时不会给关节带来太大压力。我也觉得稳定的游泳节奏很放松。

cards.audioText: How often do you play sports?
cards.audioTextZh: 你多久参加一次体育运动？
cards.referenceText: One possible sample answer is that I exercise three times a week. I usually choose short sessions that are easy to maintain around work. If my schedule changes, I focus on consistency rather than a fixed day.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是，我每周锻炼三次。我通常选择时间较短、容易在工作安排中坚持的训练。如果日程发生变化，我会重视保持规律，而不是拘泥于固定日期。

cards.audioText: Who is your favorite athlete?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的运动员是谁？
cards.referenceText: A model personal answer is that my favorite athlete is Yao Ming. I respect his skill, discipline and calm public manner. He also helped more people around the world become interested in Chinese basketball.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个个人示范答案是，我最喜欢的运动员是姚明。我敬佩他的技术、自律以及沉稳的公众形象。他还让世界各地更多人开始关注中国篮球。

cards.audioText: How often do you use a computer?
cards.referenceText: One suitable example is that I use a computer every day for work, study and communication. I may use it to review documents, prepare a flight or attend online training. I also try to take regular breaks from the screen.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是，我每天都会使用电脑工作、学习和沟通。我可能用它查看文件、准备航班或参加在线培训。我也会注意定时离开屏幕休息。

cards.audioText: How have computers changed people's lives?
cards.audioTextZh: 电脑如何改变了人们的生活？
cards.referenceText: Computers have made information, communication and many services much faster. People can work remotely, learn online and complete routine tasks more efficiently. At the same time, they need to manage privacy, unreliable information and excessive screen time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 电脑让信息获取、沟通以及许多服务变得更快捷。人们可以远程工作、在线学习，并更高效地完成日常任务。同时，人们也需要注意保护隐私、辨别不可靠信息并避免屏幕使用过度。

cards.audioText: What kind of music do you like best?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪种类型的音乐？
cards.referenceText: One suitable sample answer is that I like soft pop music best. It is easy to listen to and helps me relax without demanding too much attention. I often choose it while walking or doing simple tasks at home.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是，我最喜欢轻柔的流行音乐。这类音乐容易欣赏，也能让我放松，不会占用太多注意力。我散步或在家做简单事情时经常听这种音乐。

cards.audioText: Who is your favorite singer?
cards.referenceText: An adjustable example is that my favorite singer is Adele. I like her clear voice and the emotion in her songs. Her music is also easy to understand for an English learner.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个可调整的示范答案是，我最喜欢的歌手是阿黛尔。我喜欢她清晰的声音和歌曲中的情感。对英语学习者来说，她的音乐也比较容易听懂。

cards.audioText: How often do you go to the cinema?
cards.referenceText: One possible sample answer is that I go to the cinema only a few times a year. I usually go when a film benefits from a large screen and good sound. Most of the time, watching a movie at home is more convenient.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是，我一年只去电影院几次。通常只有当一部电影适合大银幕和优质音响时，我才会去电影院。大多数时候，在家看电影更加方便。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy shopping online?
cards.referenceText: A model personal answer is that I enjoy shopping online for ordinary items. It is convenient and makes it easy to compare products and prices. I still check the seller, delivery terms and return policy before ordering.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个个人示范答案是，我喜欢在网上购买日常用品。网购很方便，也便于比较商品和价格。不过，下单前我仍会核对卖家、配送条款和退货政策。

cards.audioText: Which website do you visit most often, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最常访问哪个网站？为什么？
cards.referenceText: One suitable example is that I visit the Aviation Weather Center website most often. It provides official weather products that are useful for study and helps me understand how conditions change. I also find its maps and reports clearly organized.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是，我最常访问航空气象中心网站。它提供适合学习使用的官方气象产品，也能帮助我理解天气状况如何变化。它的地图和报告编排得也很清楚。
